g.text: Issue 41 | Real 3D geometry, exact stored angles and exact CSV rows
LOCAL RECONSTRUCTION — separate real JLCPCB captures are in docs/repros/issue-41
Camera below the board (PCB Z<0), looking up; PCB +Y is upward. Bodies lifted 2.2 mm to expose pads; XY and rotation are preserved.
CAD rotation is read directly from the reporter's JSON.
CAD z was set from CSV under the stated hypothesis.
CAD rotation is read directly from the reporter's JSON.
CAD z was set from CSV under the stated hypothesis.
Gold circles: recorded board pad centers. Cyan circles: authored numbered contact frame on the lifted CAD.
Dashed lines join corresponding pin centers. Generic CAD dimensions are not supplier-zero calibration.
Observed: PCB rotation 90 deg and native CAD z=270 deg coexist in the same Circuit JSON.
This local mapping omits supplier zeros. See the separate calibrated JLCPCB comparison for external evidence.
Geometry: actual footprinter CAD via circuit-json-to-gltf; CPU rasterization by PoppyGL. This is not a JLCPCB capture.
No supplier-specific zero offset is applied here. The vendor experiment checks top/0 and bottom/0 controls separately.
